To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a) data dependence tracking hardware can be implemented efficiently and b) the data dependence tracking hardware is very useful in improving the performance of a branch predictor.

(a) a new branch prediction mechanism, the ARVI predictor, is developed that uses data dependence information to improve branch prediction accuracy; (b) this branch prediction mechanism is integrated into a dynamic data dependence tracking hardware mechanism; (c) the new branch prediction mechanism improves branch prediction accuracy and performance over a comparable size hybrid predictor by 12.6%.

1) a new branch predictor, the ARVI, is proposed that uses available register value information to improve branch prediction, 2) the new branch predictor has 2.6% better prediction accuracy on average over a hybrid branch predictor with the same size, and 3) the new branch prediction scheme improves the performance by 12.6%.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of hardware mechanisms to track data dependence information in a processor.
the design of a dynamic data dependence tracking mechanism and the application of the resulting data dependence information in the design of a new branch prediction design.
the design of a dynamic data dependence tracking mechanism that is used to improve branch prediction.

the data dependence tracking hardware is an efficient mechanism for tracking data dependence information.

the use of ARVI as the second-level predictor in a hybrid branch predictor is an effective method to improve branch prediction accuracy and processor performance.
